headline: Clinton order changes the rules for hiring students who finished approved federal career-related work-study programs into regular federal jobs.
what_it_does: This order changes an earlier order, Executive Order 12015, which lets federal agencies hire students who complete approved career-related work-study programs into competitive civil service jobs. The title says it amends those rules, but no summary was provided, so the exact changes are not clear.

who_it_affects.group: Students in approved federal career-related work-study programs
who_it_affects.how: The rules for moving from their work-study program into a regular federal job may change.
Agencies may follow updated rules when hiring students who finish these programs.
